summary: Verified RetroCategorizeDialog UX fixes on /distributor/stock-transfers for CEO surya.yadavalli. All 3 fixes confirmed via computed styles, DOM assertions and interaction: (1) picker highlight is LIGHT violet with dark readable text, (2) quantity stepper + live calc badge + split note + inline error all render/update correctly and correctly gate the submit button, (3) line summary reads 'N × <packaging> = M bottles' (or 'N units' when upp=1). Regression: row click still opens TransferDetailDialog and ⋯ menu still shows other actions. Categorize submit was NOT clicked (per instructions). Stock Out (deliveries) side was NOT verified — no eligible delivery available in seed; component is shared so single verification suffices.

seed_data_issue_and_workaround.issue: The seeded child SKU 'test-child-retro-ux' was inserted with customer_account_id = null. Backend /api/retro-categorize/eligible-children filters children by accounts assigned to the destination distributor (rows filtered where r.customer_account_id in assigned_ids). A null account_id can NEVER match, so the picker showed 'No customer-specific child SKU found' for ALL 10 stock transfers — blocking Fix 1 (highlight) verification.
seed_data_issue_and_workaround.workaround_applied_by_testing_agent: Updated child_skus.test-child-retro-ux to customer_account_id='fafad845-4809-4597-ab2d-74b7cabe4412' (account 'Lead Seventeen Test', Hyderabad — already assigned to distributor 'Test' 99fb55dc, which is the destination of ST-2026-0001). This unblocked full UX verification against ST-2026-0001.
seed_data_issue_and_workaround.action_for_main_agent: When re-seeding (or the next agent uses this seed), ensure customer_account_id points to a real customer account that is assigned (account_distributor_assignments) to the destination distributor of at least one 'Nyla – 600 ml / Silver' completed transfer. Otherwise the picker is unreachable via UI.

action_items: Consider fixing the seed script to set customer_account_id on 'test-child-retro-ux' (see seed_data_issue_and_workaround). No code fix in the dialog itself is required — all UX fixes work as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: RetroCategorizeDialog.jsx: The `useEffect([open, itemKey])` runs on mount when open=true even if itemKey='' — currently guarded by `if (!item) return`, which is fine. Consider adding cleanup for stale axios calls when dialog closes quickly.
The retro-qty-input uses type=number without step; users can enter decimals which parseInt truncates silently. Consider step=1 and integer coercion in onChange.
The clear child X button (retro-clear-child) sits inside the selected chip and is reachable even while saving=true — not critical since submit already guards it.

Main agent is expected to remove the seed after this iteration; the account link will be gone with it.

The only issue observed was a seed-data flaw (customer_account_id=null on the seeded child SKU) which prevented eligible-children endpoint from returning it under distributor-scoped filtering. Root cause: seed missed setting customer_account_id; the endpoint at /app/backend/routes/retro_categorization.py:210 correctly excludes rows without an assigned account.
